notes.title: Some Minor Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Happy Friday :) While plugging away at the iOS build, I came across some minor things that needed some fixing:

+ Fixed scene selection issue if you clicked ACT 3 Scene 1, the scene wouldn't start.

+ Title screen is now re-centered? Don't even ask me how it got messed up in the first place....

+ Most clickable room objects now do a little bouncy bounce when clicked.

+ Added a few lines of dialogue to the rotating painting puzzle in Paige & Finley's studio scene to let players know they need to click the painting. 

Have a good weekend!

notes.title: Mac OS now available and more!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,


First of all, thanks to everyone who's played the game so far. We've gotten a lot of positive responses, and it means a whole heck of a lot to us. Today we'd like to announce that [i]The Window Box[/i] is available on Mac OSX! We're stoked our Mac users can now play our game :)

Other than that, we've also done some smaller updates/bug fixes:

Windows & Mac: [list]
[*] Bunch of small spelling stuff
[*] Fixed the bug in the final part that caused players to get stuck in a room
[*] Fixed the living room music puzzle so you can't accidentally restart it
[*] Fixed Sophie's kitchen scene so the player can't accidentally open a cabinet twice
[/list]

Mac:
[list]
[*] Re-balanced sound effects
[/list]

Community:
[list]
[*] All the solutions to the puzzles can now be found in the "Guide" section here on Steam (Thank you Hanni!)
[*] We created a Bug Reports sub-forum so we can help fix your bugs
[/list]

That's all for now! Remember to give us a follow on our Instagram account [url=https://www.instagram.com/]@sundewstudios [/url]for more update :) 

Cheers,

Allie

notes.title: The Window Box is Now Available!
notes.content:
After two years of development, [i]The Window Box[/i] is finally out for you all to enjoy!!!

Thanks to everyone who's already purchased [i]The Window Box[/i], and to those of you who participated in our giveaways this weekend <3 We've super enjoyed all the hype over at our Instagram account ([url=https://www.instagram.com/sundewstudios/]@sundewstudios[/url]), so keep it coming!!! 

Also, please feel free to share any favorite screenshots, or any fan art. The best place to post is definitely Instagram (#TheWindowBox). If you haven't noticed, we're totally addicted to that platform.... 

Anyways, thank you all again! We hope you enjoy your stay with Elsa Parelli and her friends.

- Sundew Studios

P.S. If you find any bugs, please tell us! :)
